scope: Complete fixed two-model TRAIN diagnostic. Independent repeat is running. Proposed suffix sensitivity is not causal capture improvement or permission to promote a model.

protocol.intervention: Keep every original public input and anchor fixed. For EVERY saved candidate, copy its first k proposed command rows and replace ONLY rows k:8 with the saved public anchor commands. No private labels, future realized actions, masks or truth bins choose perturbations. k=8 is a no-change control. No filtering of candidates by measured response.
protocol.roundoff_control: For each k score [original candidates, suffix-replaced candidates, identical original candidates] in ONE batch. Retain maximum paired response repeat difference; no subtracting control differences or changing tolerances after results.
protocol.statistics: Report raw response Euclidean differences on first k offsets, restricted descriptively to original candidate/anchor common valid nonanchor points. Counts include unchanged suffix and zero-valid rows separately. Group-point equal mean, global maximum and >1e-6m and >0.05m fractions. These are model sensitivity diagnostics, not accuracy, statistical causal identification or qualification gates.
protocol.architecture_question: V10 plain action_features flattens ALL8 future commands into one shared state, and a24-output head predicts ALL8 response offsets. It does not impose proposed-command prefix invariance. Sequential native s4_rollout feeds only the current command to localCBF and the original environment per offset. Inspect sensitivity; do not infer that this structure caused the observed decision failure.
protocol.scope: Post-hoc TRAIN structural diagnostic after V28 development failure. Both pre-existing ADE-median models are fixed, not compared to choose a model. Suffix splicing can be outside prior command-library support; no new native rollout or capture result, no proof a prefix-causal replacement improves generalization. New training needs a separately frozen fresh-data matched-control protocol. Publish exact source/protocol HEAD before actual run.
